intent: Replace Playwright-owned Electron launch with owned spawn and attach-only CDP; preserve lifecycle business assertions and real chain.

playwright_local_evidence.observed: connectOverCDP browserProcess.close and kill both call doClose; doClose closes WebSocket transport and cleans artifacts directory; catch also calls doClose. No spawned Electron process handle is passed to Playwright.

mechanism.spawn: child_process.spawn electron with --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1 --remote-debugging-port=0 appRoot; windowsHide=true; shell=false; owned environment; raw stdout/stderr files opened before spawn; PID and error/exit observed from spawn; child.unref after listeners.
mechanism.attach: Read only own stderr DevTools browser WebSocket endpoint; require ws://127.0.0.1 and /devtools/browser path; chromium.connectOverCDP; require exactly one ros-app://desktop/ page.
mechanism.normal_close: Use byte-identical close-owned-window.ps1 bound to witness PID, CreatedNS, image and SHA256 to send WM_CLOSE; retain prior exit, witness retirement and exact two-PID checks.
mechanism.failure: Record UNRESOLVED with child entries and current witness; disconnect attached CDP only; no product close, kill, retry or restart. All live child entries also receive per-child unresolved records.
mechanism.scope_binding: Both wrapper and controller require all four v2 driver files to appear with hashes in a future fresh Root scope bound_files.

checks.result: Original four source files retained; PowerShell copies byte identical.
